description: This Java class demonstrates how to create a keyframe animation using AnimationDrawable in Android. It programmatically generates frames with text indicating the frame number and toggles the animation on click.

classes.name: KeyframeAnimation
classes.description: Main activity class that sets up a frame-by-frame animation using AnimationDrawable and handles user interaction to toggle the animation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the AnimationDrawable with generated frames, and defines click behavior to toggle animation.

methods.name: getDrawableForFrameNumber
methods.description: Creates a BitmapDrawable with a gray background and text indicating the frame number.
